courses.title: Reiki Sessions and Training
courses.description: Donnabelle gives Reiki sessions in the Usui/Tibetan and Holy Fire III Karuna traditions, at her studio in Easthampton, Massachusetts or at a distance, with a written follow-up after each one. She also teaches small Reiki classes from Level I and II up to Master/Teacher, with attunements, hands-on practice and a class manual.
courses.price: Reiki Session $150 (60 minutes); Reiki Level I class $300; Reiki Level II class $400

left_out: Sound therapy, Biofield Tuning and sound baths (https://sonorouslight.com/sound-healing/): still left out. The page says sound 'can help promote physical health' and that with Biofield Tuning 'most presenting symptoms can be resolved within three sessions. Long-term conditions may take longer', which reads as a claim to treat conditions. The monthly public sound bath at Wistariahurst Museum ($30) is on the same page, so it has no clean page of its own.
flags: Reiki page now carries a disclaimer that Reiki 'is not a substitute for professional medical, psychological, legal, or mental health care' and involves no diagnosis or treatment; the session wording is about stress, balance and nervous-system calm. Its opening says blocked energy 'can lead to stress or illness' and that Reiki supports 'the body's natural ability to heal'; no disease named and no cure claim, so restored under the 12 Nov rule.
Prices shown with '$' and no currency code; copied as published. The 90-minute 'Resonance Reset' ($250) on the same page blends Reiki with Biofield Tuning and is not priced in the item.
Reiki Level III (Master/Teacher, $1250) is marked 'TBA 2026'; the class prices are those published for Levels I and II.
Image omitted: the page's images are 300 px or a logo; the ingest can find one.
